v1.4.2 Update
- Fixed stuttering caused by HP updates while the Quick Panel was open, particularly in worlds with many Actors.
- Gift inventory changes update the Quick Panel without reloading relationship data.
- Quick Panel refreshes preserve the scroll position for the same owner and target.

announcement.title: 💞 Stylish Relationship Tracker v1.4.2
announcement.content:
Fixed stuttering caused by HP updates while the Quick Panel was open, particularly in worlds with many Actors.

  • HP changes no longer reload the panel's relationship data.
  • Gift inventory changes update the item list without reloading relationship data.
  • Refreshes keep the scroll position while viewing the same owner and target.
